Initial release — Automated parsing and compliance checking for Tomato Novel IP.

- Extracts structured core elements: world-building, character list, central conflict, and key highlights from novel text.
- Runs a preliminary compliance check for risky or unsafe content and provides a risk word list.
- Supports style tagging (爽文/甜宠/逆袭/玄幻/现言), with "爽文" as default.
- Designed for rapid, standardized adaptation prep for AI-based web drama/comic conversion.
- Handles large-scale novel input and outputs standardized data for downstream use.
